title: Final Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly express S as a function of H/T, indicating S = f(H/T).

title: Adiabatic Process Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain how adiabatic demagnetization leads to cooling by maintaining the ratio H/T constant.

title: Low Temperature Requirement
description: Important Criteria: The student must discuss why adiabatic demagnetization is effective only at very low temperatures.

title: Negative Temperature Concept
description: Important Criteria: The student should clarify the concept of negative temperature and its implications for achieving T = 0.

title: Partition Function Derivation
description: Optional Criteria: The student may derive the partition function correctly, showing understanding of the system's energy levels.

title: Sign and Factor Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors related to signs or factors in the equations for S and E.

title: Thermodynamic Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that the derived expressions are consistent with thermodynamic principles.
